question.text: The number of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></math> atoms in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>681</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></math> of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mn>7</mn></msub><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mn>5</mn></msub><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mn>6</mn></msub></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>21</mn></msup></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>02</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>23</mn></msup><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi>mol</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced></math> (Nearest Integer)

solution.text:
Given mass of compounds =681 g

Molar mass of C7H5N3O6=12×7+5×1+14×3+6×16

=84+5+42+96

=227

Number of moles of compound =681227=3 moles

Number of moles of N=3×number of moles of compound

=3×3=9 moles

Number of atoms of N =9×6.02×1023

=5418×1021

So x=5418
